title: Divergent HIF isoform association is linked to hypoxia responses in Mesenchymal stromal cells and human dermal fibroblasts
task: Compare hypoxia-responsive gene regulation between MSCs and fibroblasts
key_results: MSCs showed 2-4 fold more differentially expressed genes than HDFs under hypoxia; MSC responses centered on HIF1A while HDF responses aligned with HIF2A/HIF3A networks
comments: The divergent HIF isoform utilization provides mechanistic insight into cell-type-specific stress adaptation, with implications for regenerative medicine applications.

hypotheses.hypothesis: MSCs and HDFs engage equivalent adaptive programs under hypoxic stress
hypotheses.result: Rejected; divergent HIF-associated signaling architecture and cell-type-specific transcriptomic remodeling demonstrated

title: The marine drug plitidepsin alleviates osteoporosis in estrogen-deficient mice by suppressing ROS-mediated NRF2/HO-1 signaling and osteoclast formation
task: Evaluate plitidepsin efficacy in suppressing osteoclastogenesis and bone loss
key_results: Plitidepsin suppressed osteoclast formation in vitro and alleviated trabecular bone loss in OVX mice; mechanism involves ROS attenuation and NRF2/HO-1 pathway activation
comments: The marine-derived compound demonstrates dual action on oxidative stress and differentiation pathways, positioning it as a promising therapeutic candidate for estrogen-deficiency osteoporosis.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Plitidepsin alleviates estrogen-deficiency-induced bone loss by inhibiting osteoclast differentiation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; reduced osteoclast formation and function with preserved trabecular bone in OVX mice

title: Therapy using periosteal cells cultivated in microgravity or their secretome improves bone in osteoporotic rats: a proof-of-concept study
task: Assess therapeutic efficacy of microgravity-cultured periosteal cells and secretome in osteoporotic bone repair
key_results: At 42 days, secretome treatment achieved mineralized tissue equivalent to bisphosphonates and superior cortical bone thickness compared to negative control; secretome effects matched cell therapy
comments: The secretome approach offers practical advantages over cell therapy for clinical translation, though molecular mechanisms underlying the effects remained unresolved.

outputs: gene expression of bone metabolism markers

hypotheses.hypothesis: Periosteal cells cultivated in simulated microgravity have pro-osteogenic properties
hypotheses.result: Partially confirmed; secretome effects equivalent to bisphosphonates and superior in cortical thickness, but cell therapy showed intermediate mineralized tissue

title: Beauvericin exhibits antitumor activity in pancreatic cancer cells: Integrative analysis suggests potential modulation of the KEAP1-NRF2-HMOX1 axis and survival signaling pathways
task: Investigate Beauvericin antitumor mechanisms in pancreatic cancer cells
key_results: Beauvericin reduced Mia PaCa-2 cell viability (IC50 1.45 µM), suppressed migration, and increased apoptosis to 50.06%; molecular docking predicted KEAP1 interaction with modulation of AKT/ERK1/2/STAT3 survival signaling
comments: The integrative computational and experimental approach suggests KEAP1-NRF2 axis modulation as a plausible mechanism, though direct KEAP1 binding validation remains needed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Beauvericin inhibits pancreatic cancer cell survival through KEAP1-NRF2-HMOX1 axis and AKT/ERK1/2/STAT3 signaling
hypotheses.result: Supported by molecular docking, MD simulations, and protein expression data; direct binding confirmation pending

title: 3-O-Acetylrubiarbonol B induces apoptosis of colorectal cancer cells by activating JNK/p38 MAPK and ROS generation
task: Elucidate apoptotic mechanisms of 3-O-Acetylrubiarbonol B in colorectal cancer cells
key_results: ARu-B induced apoptosis in HCT116 and oxaliplatin-resistant HCT116-OxR cells (IC50 5.4 and 4.0 µM) via JNK/p38 MAPK phosphorylation, ROS generation, and caspase activation
comments: The compound's efficacy against oxaliplatin-resistant cells suggests potential for overcoming drug resistance, though in vivo validation is needed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: ARu-B-induced apoptosis requires JNK/p38 MAPK signaling and ROS generation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; inhibitors of JNK, p38, and ROS scavenging prevented cytotoxicity

title: Predicting measles outbreak magnitude via modeled population susceptibility evidence from pre-vaccination data
task: Predicting measles outbreak magnitude from reconstructed population susceptibility
key_results: Reconstructed susceptibility (S0) strongly associated with observed attack rates; model accurately reproduced temporal dynamics across all regions
comments: Practical surveillance-based approach but relies on historical data quality and assumes seasonality patterns remain constant.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Reconstructed S0 predicts subsequent observed attack rates
hypotheses.result: Strongly associated; practical predictive value demonstrated

title: Optimizing CRISPR–Cas9-mediated TCR knockout in primary mouse CD8+, CD4+, and regulatory T cells
task: Optimizing CRISPR–Cas9 RNP-mediated TCR knockout in primary mouse T cell subsets
key_results: >98% knockout in Jurkat cells; 95% in CD8+, 80% in CD4+, 85% in Tregs; confirmed by Sanger sequencing and ICE analysis; cells retained activation capacity
comments: Robust non-viral platform with practical utility; Treg editing efficiency is notable but modest viability reduction may limit applications.

inputs: Primary mouse CD4+, CD8+, Treg cells

hypotheses.hypothesis: Optimized sgRNA design, Cas9:sgRNA ratio, cell number, and RNP dose maximize TCR knockout in primary mouse T cells
hypotheses.result: Up to 95% CD8+ and 85% Treg knockout with minimal viability loss; CD4+ achieved 80%

title: Quokka swarm defensive optimization-based ensemble deep learning for disease prediction using remote monitoring data
task: Disease prediction from physiological monitoring data using optimized ensemble deep learning
key_results: QSDO_Ensemble DL achieved 96.90% accuracy, 95.87% TPR, 7.22% FPR on MIMIC-II database
comments: High reported metrics on single dataset; validation on external cohorts and ablation studies would strengthen claims.

model_io.model: QSDO_Ensemble DL (ResNeXt, AHANet, SA-Net with hyperparameter tuning)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Ensemble deep learning with QSDO hyperparameter tuning improves disease prediction robustness
hypotheses.result: Achieved 96.90% accuracy with low FPR

title: Leakage-aware hybrid tabular deep learning with target-provenance auditing for calorie-expenditure prediction and constrained exercise food recommendation
task: Audit-first tabular deep learning framework for calorie expenditure prediction with constrained exercise-food recommendation
key_results: Post-leakage-removal MAE 101.68 kcal (1.7% above theoretical floor of 100 kcal); recommender achieved 80% profile coverage with no constraint violations
comments: Exemplary approach to target variable validation; theoretical floor analysis is elegant but outcome data quality fundamentally limits utility.

model_io.model: Three architectures: Tabular 1D-CNN, feature-token Transformer, BiLSTM+Transformer
outputs: MAE, bootstrap CI, Wilcoxon test results

hypotheses.hypothesis: Outcome variable is noisy (Uniform 100-500 kcal equivalent); hybrid tabular DL approaches the theoretical prediction floor
hypotheses.result: MAE 101.68 kcal within 1.7% of theoretical bound; distributional forensics confirmed outcome indistinguishability from uniform noise

title: Missing data imputation for wearable time series
task: Imputation of missing physiological data in wearable time series by modeling periodic dependencies
key_results: PMSI outperformed five standard methods (RMSE 7.53 vs. 8.18–10.01 in high-adherence cohort); identified daily and 3.5-day periodicities in missingness
comments: Clever exploitation of smartwatch charging cycles; framework generalizable but device-specific patterns may limit portability.

inputs: Smartwatch heart rate time series (558 high-adherence, 1957 low-adherence participant-months)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Modeling multi-scale periodic dependencies in both observations and missingness improves imputation accuracy
hypotheses.result: PMSI achieved lowest RMSE and MAE across both cohorts; identified daily and 3.5-day periodicities

title: Prototype-based explainable deep learning for sex classification of Mountain Gazelles in the wild
task: Explainable deep learning for sex classification in endangered Mountain Gazelles using camera trap imagery
key_results: Prototype-based model achieved 75% accuracy and F1-score with transparent visual reasoning; prototypes captured morphological traits including sex-specific horn features
comments: Novel approach balancing interpretability with accuracy; limited dataset (1833 crops) and reliance on bounding box quality warrant careful field deployment.

inputs: Camera trap images of Mountain Gazelles (1833 cropped bounding boxes)
outputs: Explanation features (body, leg, head, horn regions)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Non-fixed prototype learning captures larger, semantically coherent regions relevant to sex dimorphism
hypotheses.result: Model identified central body, leg, head, and horn features; males distinguished via horn-related prototypes

title: Comparative genomics of Actinomyces identifies an MRONJ-associated lineage characterized by variation in mfd
task: Comparative genomics identifying MRONJ-associated Actinomyces lineage with mfd gene variation
key_results: Most MRONJ-derived isolates clustered in Actinomyces oris-dominated lineage with distinct mfd variant; 3D structure prediction identified potential Mfd differences
comments: Solid genomic characterization but functional significance of mfd variation and MRONJ causality remain speculative pending additional validation.

model_io.model: Comparative genomic analysis with structure prediction

hypotheses.hypothesis: MRONJ-associated Actinomyces lineage harbors distinct mfd variant with potential structural differences
hypotheses.result: Most isolates clustered in A. oris-dominated lineage; 3D predictions identified potential Mfd structural variation

title: A course recommendation method based on bidirectional fusion of graph convolution using knowledge graphs
task: Course recommendation via bidirectional fusion of knowledge graph and user preference propagation
key_results: KGCN-RN achieved competitive or superior performance vs. baselines on MOOCCube; improved HR and NDCG metrics
comments: Addresses cold-start and sparsity but evaluation limited to one public dataset; generalization to other domains unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Joint modeling of user preference propagation and course semantic aggregation improves recommendations
hypotheses.result: Bidirectional fusion strategy improved accuracy and ranking quality

title: Integrated multi-omics analyses reveal the role of PAXX in colorectal cancer progression and the tumor immune microenvironment
task: Multi-omics investigation of PAXX role in colorectal cancer progression and tumor immune microenvironment
key_results: PAXX upregulated in CRC; knockdown suppressed proliferation/migration/invasion; MAPK/ERK signaling identified as partial mediator; high PAXX associated with distinct immune/stromal profiles
comments: Comprehensive functional validation but mechanistic link between PAXX, EMT, and immune modulation remains partially inferred; single-cell CellChat predictions require experimental confirmation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: PAXX promotes CRC progression via MAPK/ERK signaling and EMT
hypotheses.result: PAXX knockdown suppressed MAPK/ERK phosphorylation and EMT; EGF rescue partially reversed effects

hypotheses.hypothesis: PAXX expression associates with distinct immune and stromal characteristics
hypotheses.result: High PAXX linked to specific immune/stromal profiles; heterogeneous PAXX in scRNA-seq

title: Complement C3a receptor expression is associated with distinct immune microenvironmental profiles in clear cell renal cell carcinoma
task: Characterizing C3aR expression and immune microenvironment associations in clear cell renal cell carcinoma
key_results: C3aR predominantly on myeloid cells (98% CD68+, 68% CD163+); associated with distinct immune profiles but not independent survival predictor
comments: Multi-omics integration is thorough; however, C3aR is a marker rather than causal driver, limiting therapeutic implications.

model_io.model: Integrated transcriptomic, immunohistochemistry, and single-cell analyses

hypotheses.hypothesis: C3aR expression marks a specific myeloid-associated immune context distinct from total macrophage abundance
hypotheses.result: C3aR+ density inversely correlated with CD68+ macrophage density; identified three immune profiles linked to disease aggressiveness

title: A multi-algorithm generative framework for urban design: integrating road networks, green spaces and building forms
task: Generate urban design schemes integrating road networks, green spaces and building forms via multi-algorithm workflow
key_results: End-to-end generation for 10 km² scheme in 3 min 48.23 s; framework demonstrated generalisability across 20 sites of varying scales and contexts
comments: Systematic decomposition and sequential generation (roads → green space → buildings) ensures spatial coherence; AI-aided workflow advances design practice efficiency.

model_io.model: Multi-algorithm urban design framework (road network, green space, building generation)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Systematic generation sequence ensures spatial rationality and coherence
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: framework generalized across 20 sites; end-to-end generation time efficient at 3:48 for 10 km²

title: UPF4ROS2 for integrating planner independent task planning into ROS 2
task: Integrate automated planning framework into ROS 2 for robot task execution
key_results: Equivalent mission-level behaviour and plan lengths vs. baseline; sub-second planning-service latencies in controlled replanning
comments: Planner-independent integration achieved without compromise in autonomous execution, though temporal-numeric benchmarks showed measurable overhead.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Planner-independent integration preserves autonomous task execution performance

title: A stability-oriented framework based on adaptive hunger games search for non-convex economic dispatch
task: Solve non-convex economic dispatch with valve-point effects and multiple operational constraints
key_results: AHGS achieved best Friedman rank 2.18 over 21 ED benchmarks; reduced run-to-run std dev by 77.49% vs. HGS; statistically significant wins on CEC2020
comments: Adaptive hunger games search stabilizes the algorithm via quadratic shrink control and population reduction; competitive with L-HMDE and DE despite lower per-evaluation complexity.

title: Detailed identification method of blue and white porcelain decorative patterns for cultural heritage protection

key_results: ResNet50 highest overall accuracy; MobileNetV3 more consistent subgroup performance; persistent demographic disparities in intersectional analysis despite accuracy gains

key_results: Significant improvements in personalization accuracy and adaptation speed vs. baseline methods on multilingual student logs

task: Predict bending load of CaCO₃-filled polypropylene composites under small-sample conditions
key_results: Optimized XGBoost on 249-sample dataset achieved R² 0.8061 with lowest MSE; cubic spline interpolation significantly improved model performance

title: Joint entropy-aware quantization for energy-efficient TinyML human activity recognition on IoT edge devices
task: Energy-efficient human activity recognition on IoT edge devices via entropy-aware quantization
key_results: JEAQ-HAR achieves macro-F1 95.1%, 93.1%, 90.1% (UCI-HAR, WISDM, PAMAP2) with 0.47pp gap from FP32; 81.7% package-size reduction; 5.93ms/0.47mJ end-to-end inference
comments: Hierarchical mixed-precision allocation based on multi-scale entropy and adaptive routing effectively balances accuracy and efficiency; comprehensive deployment evaluation is strong.

title: Time-scaled quantum simulation of dissipative nanoelectronics with zero gate overhead
task: Simulate open quantum systems with Lindblad dissipation on NISQ processors without active dissipative gates
key_results: Hardware-intrinsic time-scaling method maps T₁ relaxation to native delays with zero ancillary-qubit overhead; 4-qubit tight-binding model validated on IBM architectures for magnon and phonon transport with lower RMSE than stochastic-reset baseline
comments: Clever exploitation of NISQ device constraints as a feature rather than a bug; demonstrated only on 2–4 qubits and single-excitation manifolds, so scaling and multi-excitation regimes remain open.

model_io.model: Single-excitation tight-binding Hamiltonian with amplitude-damping Lindblad channel, mapped to IBM quantum processor via intrinsic-delay time-scaling

hypotheses.hypothesis: Native T₁-based delays can substitute active dissipative gates without additional 2-qubit-gate cost
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: zero additional gates; depth-dependent delay mitigation reduces saturation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Intrinsic-delay construction outperforms stochastic-reset and Stinespring comparators in trajectory fidelity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: lower trajectory-shape RMSE in 2-qubit benchmark

title: A compact 2D photonic crystal biosensor for optical detection of glioblastoma brain tissues enhanced by neural networks
task: Develop compact 2D photonic crystal biosensor for glioblastoma detection enhanced by neural network classification
key_results: Quality factor 4777, figure of merit 2333, sensitivity 933 nm/RIU, detection limit 4.2 × 10⁻⁵ RIU, thermal stability 25–40 °C, ANN achieves high-accuracy tumor/pre-tumor discrimination with smaller footprint than prior art

hypotheses.hypothesis: ANN classification of sensor response discriminates glioblastoma from pre-tumor tissue

hypotheses.hypothesis: Different optical power distribution architectures affect cell pitch scalability

title: Spin–orbit–controlled flat-band transition, thermodynamic and magnetic response in a disordered Lieb-5 lattice
task: Investigate flat-band reconstruction in disordered Lieb-5 lattice under spin-orbit coupling
key_results: ISOC transforms two flat bands into single FB at zero energy; disorder broadens spectrum and modulates heat capacity peaks and paramagnetic susceptibility amplitude
comments: The SCBA treatment is standard for disorder but the interplay of three mechanisms (FB physics, ISOC, impurity scattering) is well-articulated and experimentally relevant for engineering tunable quantum materials.

model_io.model: Tight-binding Green's function with self-consistent Born approximation

hypotheses.hypothesis: ISOC progressively weakens flat-band features
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: two FB structure merged into single FB

hypotheses.hypothesis: Disorder and ISOC jointly tune thermodynamic response
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: tunable heat capacity peaks and disorder-dependent susceptibility amplitude
